beaches.name: Ouranoupoli
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in a cove beyond the Ouranoupoli town beach. A naturist directory carries one undated visitor report of a fortnight of nude use past the rocks and a 2017 note on nearby Drenia and Pena islets; the same directory states the Athos peninsula generally shows no tolerance for nudity. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Posidi
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the beach west of Cape Posidi. A naturist directory carries reports from 2006 and 2007 with the nude share ranging from 25% in August to 70-90% off-season; a second directory carries a June 2017 report of many nudists. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Afitos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in a cove beyond rocks north of Afitos main beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001, 2007 and 2016; the 2016 report describes nude snorkelling without incident, while the larger sandy area stayed clothed. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agios Mamas
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported east of the watch tower on the beach past Nea Potidea. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2022; the western part stays clothed, and a 2016 report describes nude and clothed bathers side by side near the tower with no objection. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Kavourotrypes
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised in the smaller coves to the right of the main cove. The main cove with the beach bar is swimwear use; a naturist directory (2022) and visitors (2021, 2025) report nudist signboards on the rocks at the right end. No municipal designation is documented; a 2026 local guide calls the use unofficial.

beaches.name: Kalamitsi nudist cove
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is the norm on the small third cove east of Kalamitsi’s main beach. Naturist directories report it as mostly or fully nude since 2007, with long-stay tents; the main beach is swimwear use. No designation or signage is recorded.

beaches.name: North Platanitsi
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed use mix on the undeveloped coves north of Platanitsi camping. Directory reports (2006–2022) describe the northern beach as clothing-optional and the smaller coves south of it as fully nude; the camping beach itself is swimwear use. The source states it is not an official nude beach.

beaches.name: Paradise Beach (Destenika–Aretes)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers share this unsigned cove north of Toroni. A naturist directory reports a 30–70% naturist share (2014) and a mostly Greek naturist camp (2021); a 2023 visit notes nudity is not required. Unauthorised camping structures at nearby Aretes were cleared by the municipality in August 2026.

beaches.name: Kriaritsi
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the small coves south-east of the main beach. Directory reports from 2015–2022 conflict: some describe the coves as fully nude with free campers, one says a beach bar on the cliffs ended nude use there; the main beach is swimwear use. The municipality cleared unauthorised camping structures here in August 2026.

beaches.name: Bara
beaches.summary: Nude use is reported across this small cove south of Fava beach at Vourvourou. A naturist directory carries two visitor reports, from July 2021 and May 2022, both finding few people and most of them nude. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Portokali (Orange) Beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the rocks right of the main Portokali beach. A naturist directory carries a 2022 visitor report describing the main beach as swimwear with a signposted nudist spot on the rocks; an older undated report put the beach at 50-70% nude. Who placed the signboards is not documented.

beaches.name: Porto Karras coves
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in small coves along the Porto Karras coast. A naturist directory describes about 5 km of small beaches below the estate road, with a 2022 update reporting mostly nude use. The land belongs to the resort; no stated policy is documented.
